results.text: That was 16 seconds from button start, and the even flow makes a fast/even under-extracted shot the likely issue—not channeling. Keep 18 g in and 36 g out, then move the Barista Express grinder one small step finer from 5. Aim for a slower shot and judge it by whether sourness softens and sweetness increases. Your older dry-finish note used a different grinder and cup, so it doesn’t outweigh this fresh result.
